title: The Voice in the Void
logline: A supposed prophet claims a derelict station speaks to them, demanding tribute from poor believers, but they are just using a tightbeam comms relay to fake it.

roles.description: Charismatic, deeply manipulative, entirely focused on extracting wealth from believers.
A poor worker who gave their life savings to the prophet, utterly convinced of the miracles.
A gilded, heavily defended luxury yacht disguised as a humble pilgrimage vessel.
A dark, silent, abandoned listening post that believers think is a holy artifact.
A growing movement of desperate people giving away everything they own.

public_situation: A rapidly growing {role:cult_following} believes that the {role:derelict_shrine} is broadcasting divine visions directly into the mind of their leader.
private_truth: The prophet is using a hidden tightbeam transmitter on their luxury ship to bounce synthetic audio files off the derelict's old antenna arrays.

beats.public_change: The prophet demands a massive physical tithe, claiming the shrine requires an offering to speak again.

missions.reason: Hires the pilot to securely dock at the shrine and deliver a massive crate of valuable tech scrap as an offering.
missions.private_fact: The follower sold their own ship to afford the scrap.

beats.public_change: The shrine broadcasts a terrifying new prophecy, causing mass panic among the believers.

missions.reason: The terrified follower asks the pilot to scan the prophet's ship, hoping to find a way to shield the prophet from the 'pain' of the visions.
missions.private_fact: The scan reveals the tightbeam array actively broadcasting the synthetic voices.

missions.reason: The prophet asks the pilot to fetch a 'holy relic' from the shrine.
missions.private_fact: It's just the old tightbeam bounce-plate, which needs maintenance.

beats.public_change: The prophet announces a final, system-wide holy war against non-believers.

missions.reason: The follower, now knowing the truth, pays the pilot with the last of their savings to destroy the prophet's yacht.
missions.private_fact: The prophet will offer a cut of the cult's tithes to spare their life.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the prophet's ship.
resolutions.summary: The prophet is killed in combat. The believers think they were martyred by a demon, cementing their faith forever, though the voices stop.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the prophet's bribe.
resolutions.summary: The pilot gets rich, while the prophet flees the system with the cult's money. The cult collapses into infighting.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot keeps quiet or ignores the situation.
resolutions.summary: The cult takes over the local sector, draining the populace dry as the prophet buys more yachts.

loose_threads.detail: The synthetic audio files used for the prophecy perfectly match the voice prints of a famously murdered corporate CEO.
The follower mentions their entire life savings was instantly transferred to an off-world holding company the moment they donated it.

radio_hooks: Mass gatherings reported near the {role:derelict_shrine} as believers await the next word.
Local authorities warn of increased scams targeting the spiritually vulnerable.

voice_direction.false_prophet: Loud, hypnotic cadence. Rises in pitch at the end of every sentence.
voice_direction.devout_follower: Quiet, reverent rhythm. Pauses before speaking a holy name.
